## Machine-Readable Files
- `index.json` - full category, namespace, and example metadata
- `search-index.json` - search, SEO, and agent discovery metadata
- `examples-index.md` - task-oriented example index with search phrases
- `readiness.json` - compact scoring/readiness evidence
- `AGENTS.md` - repository-level coding-agent guidance
- `<category>/AGENTS.md` - category-specific coding-agent guidance
- `<category>/README.md` - category-level human and agent navigation
